featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: I wish there was a zero-star option on Google because this was a truly horrible experience at Cinepolis Magnet Mall, Bhandup. I, Jay, went to watch the movie "Obsession" with my friend. Another friend had booked the tickets but couldn't make it due to a personal reason. He gave us the ticket QR screenshot, and Vikas Jha, the watchman, checked it and let us in. However, before the interval, we were stopped three times inside the cinema by different Cinepolis executives—Anuyog, Nagesh, and another. We kept showing them the ticket. But during the interval, Anuyog dragged me outside, insisting the ticket was invalid. I had him contact BookMyShow support, who confirmed the ticket was legitimate. Still, Cinepolis did nothing to help. We were told to leave mid-movie, and they asked us to pay again directly to them for a new ticket. The way Anuyog and Nagesh treated us was disgraceful. After returning home, I had to raise a formal complaint with BookMyShow, who thankfully issued a refund. But Cinepolis, you have a long way to go. Stay away if you value a hassle-free cinema experience.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Aher
featured_reviews.review_text:
🎬 INOX IMAX – R City Mall, Ghatkopar | Honest IMAX Experience Review

I recently watched an IMAX screening at INOX IMAX R City Mall, and here’s a clear, no-nonsense review based on the actual experience.

Overall Experience: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4/5)

What Works Well:
•	IMAX scale & immersion: The auditorium delivers the signature IMAX feel with a massive screen and powerful surround sound, making it a good choice for big-budget, visually heavy films.
•	Comfortable environment: The hall is clean, well-maintained, and acoustics are solid, especially for action and background scores.
•	Location advantage: Being inside R City Mall makes it convenient with ample food and parking options.

What Could Be Better:
•	Projection quality (3D): While watching Avatar: Fire and Ash in 3D, the visuals felt noticeably blurred. A laser IMAX projection would have significantly improved sharpness, brightness, and depth.
•	Seats: The seating is decent but not premium. For long IMAX movies, better cushioning and ergonomics would enhance comfort.
•	3D clarity: Fast-moving scenes lacked crispness, which slightly broke immersion—something you don’t expect from an IMAX-branded screen.

Final Verdict:
INOX IMAX R City Mall is good for IMAX movies, especially if you value screen size and sound, but it falls short of a true next-gen IMAX experience due to the non-laser projection and average seating. Upgrade to laser projection and better seats, and this could easily become one of Mumbai’s top IMAX destinations.

Recommended for: Big action / spectacle films
Not ideal for: Viewers sensitive to 3D blur or expecting laser-sharp visuals

To begin with, finding the theatre was quite confusing. There were no boards, signs, or posters indicating that a theatre was located there. My cab dropped me right in front of the building, but I still couldn’t see any clear markings to confirm I was at the right place.

Next, after completing the ticket check and heading upstairs, I noticed there were very few seats available for waiting. Only about ten people could sit on a sofa, and the rest had to stand until roughly ten minutes before the show began. So, if you arrive early, be prepared to wait standing.

Another issue — (Screen 2) avoid seats D19 and D20 in the upper section. Your view will be blocked by a gypsum board placed directly in front.

The seating overall is not very comfortable, especially for back support. The sound quality was also below expectations, lacking smoothness and clarity.

Like in many theatres, disturbances were present: people searching for seats with mobile flashlights after the movie started, crying babies, phone conversations, latecomers, people recording videos, and vendors distributing popcorn mid-show etc.

Speaking of popcorn — I paid ₹460 for one serving and ₹70 for a half-litre bottle of mineral water. Including my travel, I spent around ₹1,500 just to watch a movie.

Finally, a serious safety concern: when exiting after the show, you must use the stairs. Some steps are partially damaged, making it risky to walk in a crowd. Today, I even witnessed a man fall while carrying a small child because of the broken steps. Please be cautious.

featured_reviews.name: Dev Sai
featured_reviews.review_text:
My visit to INOX Neelyog in Ghatkopar East was a bit of a mixed experience. While the theatre itself is okay, it feels like a bit of a deserted venue. The mall it’s located in is quite old, and despite being owned by PVR-INOX, the place feels stuck in time, lacking the modern amenities you’d expect from their brand. It doesn’t have the same fresh, updated atmosphere as other PVR-INOX theatres.

Its proximity to the Ghatkopar Railway Station makes it a convenient choice for moviegoers relying on public transport.

The seating was decent, but there was nothing exceptional about it. The overall maintenance seemed lacking, and the place just felt a bit neglected. The staff were polite, but the overall service felt a bit lackluster, especially when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres. The staff seemed understaffed, and there were minor delays in service, particularly at the concession stand. As for maintenance, it was evident that the theatre could use some attention. The cleanliness in the common areas and washrooms was below par, and the seats, though functional, showed signs of wear and tear.

The ticket prices were reasonable, but when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres, this one doesn’t justify the price for the experience it offers. Snacks were also the standard fare, but the portions were smaller, and they didn’t feel as fresh.

In summary, while it wasn’t a terrible experience, it felt more like a theatre stuck in the past, lacking the vibrant and well-maintained vibe you’d expect from a PVR-INOX property. It’s good if you're in the area, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it.

I recently visited Metro INOX Cinema, and my overall experience was extremely enjoyable and comfortable. This cinema hall perfectly blends a classic feel with modern movie-watching amenities, making it a great choice for both regular viewers and cinema lovers who appreciate a well-maintained theatre.

The screen and sound quality were excellent. The visuals were sharp, bright, and immersive, which made the movie even more engaging. The sound system was well balanced—loud enough to create impact without being overwhelming. Dialogues were clear, and background music and effects were crisp, enhancing the overall cinematic experience.

The seating arrangement deserves special mention. The seats were comfortable, well-spaced, and offered a clear view of the screen from almost every angle. Legroom was sufficient, allowing for a relaxed experience even during a long movie. The auditorium was clean and well maintained, which added to the comfort level.

The ambience of Metro INOX has a pleasant and premium feel. The lobby area was neat, organized, and not overly crowded. The lighting and interiors give a classy vibe, making the wait time before the show quite comfortable. Entry and exit were well managed, avoiding unnecessary rush or confusion.

Food and beverages were also satisfactory. The snacks counter offered the usual cinema favourites like popcorn, cold drinks, and nachos. While prices are on the higher side—as expected in multiplexes—the quality and freshness were good. The staff at the counter were polite and quick in handling orders, even during peak hours.

Another positive aspect was the staff behavior and overall management. The staff members were helpful, courteous, and ensured smooth operations throughout the show. Ticket checking, seating guidance, and cleanliness were handled efficiently. Restrooms were clean and well maintained, which is an important factor for any public place.

Overall, Metro INOX Cinema provides a reliable, comfortable, and enjoyable movie-watching experience. Whether you’re going for a weekend show with friends, a family outing, or a solo movie break, this place delivers on quality, comfort, and ambience. I would definitely recommend Metro INOX Cinema to anyone looking for a pleasant and hassle-free cinema experience.

What sets Natraj Cinema apart is its diverse selection of films. Families flock to Natraj Cinema for its family-friendly screenings, creating cherished memories together.

featured_reviews.name: Venkat Krishnan

AC was very powerful, seats very comfortable, picture and sound quality excellent, canteen used to serve tasty samosas, snacks and beverages at reasonable prices. Management was talking pains to maintain the ambience and decor. But over the period, due to poor management, improper maintenance, the quality deteriorated gradually and it has come to the present stage. Added to all these, competition from multiplexes has caused further damage. Most surprising is still it continues to run against all odds is something great. I doubt will there be any scope for improvement. The best option will be to sell the land to some potential builder who can build Shopping mall or residential tower, as the place is strategically located (very close to railway station and bus stop ). Rest is left to God.

featured_reviews.name: Krittika Khandare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to document a serious food safety incident at PVR, Jio World Plaza, BKC.

On 15 January 2026, I attended the 6:00 PM show of Avatar 3 in Audi 6. Before the movie, I purchased food from the PVR counter. While eating it during the show, the final bite contained a visible piece of glass that entered my mouth. I immediately spat it out. The fact that I was not physically injured was purely a matter of luck, this could have caused severe internal injury or worse.

I have video evidence clearly showing the glass shard in the food.

What has been equally disturbing is the way this matter has been handled since. Despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and assurances that the issue was being taken seriously, there were significant delays, inconsistent communication, and ultimately a response stating that no lapse could be established at their end. The only gesture initially offered was complimentary movie tickets, which is entirely inappropriate for a life-threatening food safety incident.

As a paying customer, being exposed to such a risk and then experiencing weeks of delay and deflection has been deeply distressing. This review is being posted so that other patrons are aware and so that this concern is documented publicly after private escalation failed to lead to a responsible resolution.

I hope PVR reviews its food safety accountability and customer handling practices more seriously going forward.

Visited Jio PVR recently for an evening weekday show. The theatre itself was extremely clean, the seats were very comfortable, and the cooling was VERY strong — honestly, carry a jacket if you’re planning to watch a movie there because it gets quite cold inside. The overall ambience and maintenance were excellent.

Ticket pricing between ₹250–₹500 feels reasonable considering the cleanliness and comfort, especially if booked smartly on weekdays.

But as usual with PVR, the food pricing is absurd. Ordered a ₹350 Schezwan Paneer Wrap and it was a complete waste of money. The taste was terrible and definitely not worth the price. They serve it properly with a tray, plate, and cutlery, but realistically, how convenient is that setup inside a movie theatre while watching a film in the dark?

Popcorn and drinks are also heavily overpriced, and the quantity doesn’t justify the cost either.

Overall: great theatre experience for seating, cleanliness, and ambience — but avoid spending too much on the food unless you’re okay paying premium prices for average quality.

featured_reviews.name: Kunal Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Odeon Luxe promises a premium movie experience with its reclining seats, plush interiors, and modern amenities that elevate comfort for moviegoers.

While the ambience and seating do offer a touch of luxury, the high ticket pricing may not feel justified for all, especially given inconsistencies in cleanliness, (broken) seats, bad smell and staff service. These operational lapses can take away from what could otherwise be a seamless cinema experience.

In summary, Odeon Luxe delivers on comfort (especially for nearby residents), but expectations around service and hygiene may not always be met. Worth considering for the comfort factor, but manage expectations on the rest.
